note: Set A is better because its claims extracting data from the Bode plot generally include quotes containing the specific numerical values (e.g., quoting '-75' for a -75 deg claim), whereas Set B frequently uses the figure caption as the quote for specific data points, which provides no evidence for the numbers. Both sets contain hallucinated duplicate claims with mismatched values (e.g., claiming -80 deg while quoting -75) and both misread the phase at 0.10 Hz as -30 deg (likely reading the axis tick instead of the curve). Set A has fewer unsupported or inconsistent claims overall.
